# Reduced real Round 24 live matchInterchange diagnostic evidence (Issue #204 / PR #206)
#
# This is a hand-trimmed excerpt of the human-readable output of
# `scripts/report_interchange_evidence.py`, run by the repository owner
# against a deployment's populated `match_interchange_evidence_observations`
# table (Issue #193's `interchange` diagnostic profile), covering 7 real
# Round 24 matches. It is genuinely captured evidence, not an invented
# payload -- but it is a reduced excerpt (~40 of ~4900 lines in the
# original supplied report), not the full report, and it carries no
# individual Champion Data player IDs or raw per-poll payloads (the report
# tool does not print them by default) -- see the metadata sidecar and
# `afl_json/match_interchange.py` module docstring "Array-membership
# semantics: confirmed by real Round 24 live evidence" for exactly what
# this format can and cannot prove.
#
# "..." marks elided lines (both within a match's sequence and between
# matches) -- see the full aggregate counts in the metadata sidecar and the
# design doc for totals computed over the complete supplied report.
